summary.zh-CN: 上传指标词典、仪表盘导出、实验记录与用户反馈即可开始：指标口径核对与复算、实验结论对照决策规则、反馈主题归类统计、增长周报，每个数字可复算、每条结论指向来源；不改埋点与线上配置，不决定实验全量或回滚，不对外发布实验结论。
summary.en: Start from uploaded metric dictionaries, dashboard exports, experiment records and user feedback: metric definition checks with recomputation, experiment readouts against decision rules, feedback theme clustering and growth weekly reports, with every figure recomputable and every conclusion sourced; it never changes tracking or live configuration, decides to ship or roll back experiments, or publishes experiment conclusions externally.

now.zh-CN: 按指标词典用原始计数复算仪表盘数字，带符号写出差异与算式，并列跨来源口径冲突
now.en: Recompute dashboard figures from raw counts per the metric dictionary, with signed differences and formulas, and list cross-source definition conflicts side by side

now.zh-CN: 复算实验各组主指标与护栏，逐条对照预设决策规则，结论只写符合、不符合或无法判定
now.en: Recompute primary and guardrail metrics per experiment group and check each pre-set decision rule; the verdict is only meets, does not meet or cannot determine

now.zh-CN: 反馈去重后逐条标注并归并主题，条数与占比可复算，安全与越权反馈单列转交
now.en: De-duplicate and tag feedback, group it into themes with recomputable counts and shares, and list security and access issues separately for hand-off

now.zh-CN: 生成增长周报：核心指标环比（计数写百分比、比率写百分点）、实验进展、反馈要点与需决策事项
now.en: Produce growth weekly reports: week-over-week core metrics (counts as percentages, rates as percentage points), experiment progress, feedback highlights and open decisions

needs.zh-CN: 指标词典、仪表盘导出或原始计数表、实验计划与结果导出、用户反馈导出、运营动作记录
needs.en: Metric dictionary, dashboard exports or raw count tables, experiment plans and result exports, user feedback exports, operations logs

needs.zh-CN: 统计周期与时区、报告精度、周报读者、实验的预设决策规则
needs.en: Reporting period and time zone, reporting precision, report audience, and pre-registered experiment decision rules

needs.zh-CN: 可选：PostHog、Exa 连接器（海外服务，均需密钥），用于读取指标与实验结果、检索公开资料
needs.en: Optional: PostHog and Exa connectors (overseas services, credentials required) to read metrics and experiment results and search public material

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide for the task

permissions.zh-CN: 不改埋点、指标定义、仪表盘或线上配置，不执行实验全量、扩量或回滚，不回复用户
permissions.en: Never changes tracking, metric definitions, dashboards or live configuration, never ships, ramps up or rolls back experiments, and never replies to users

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：发送报告或结论、对外发布实验结论、把数据上传到外部平台
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: sending reports or conclusions, publishing experiment conclusions externally, uploading data to external platforms

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-26 真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离宿主）验收未全部通过，保持 content-only：指标口径核对、实验结论整理、增长周报三个模板产出结构与期望一致、数字可复算；用户反馈归类两轮都出现计数错误（编出不存在的编号、漏归或错归条目、去重数前后不一），反馈条数与占比须人工复核。
conditions.en: Real-model acceptance (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated host) on 2026-09-26 did not fully pass, so this stays content-only: metric definition check, experiment readout and weekly report matched the expected structure with recomputable numbers; feedback clustering miscounted in both runs (an invented ID, dropped or misassigned items, inconsistent duplicate counts), so feedback counts and shares need manual review.

conditions.zh-CN: 产品分析与搜索连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Product analytics and search connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
